notes: YOK-253 opt-in crouch-guard bot (Sparring Partner special-spam report 2026-11-14, F3 rec. 3c; C3). Not a default anywhere: it plays only through --bot data/harness/newcomer-kihon-bot-crouch-guard.json. It is the newcomer bot with exactly one value added: fight.crouch_guard_pct 100. Inside a guard it already holds (a block_pct block or an idle guard), a seen low (a move of the opponent's kit marked low, e.g. Oni Quake, recognised by the move the delayed screen shows, P6) or a shot that flies over a crouching body box (Foxfire: hitbox y 240-290 over the crouching 0-240) gets one roll; on success the guard holds down-back until its plan ends. It does not add guards: block_pct and idle_guard_pct stay the newcomer's. The calibrated levels are untouched (R5). Smoke use only; no balance verdict (YOK-256).
